opinions.text: C. A. 8th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 441 U. S. 942.] Motion for appointment of counsel granted, and it is ordered that James W. Erwin, Esquire, of St. Louis, Mo., be appointed to serve as counsel for respondent in this case provided he applies for admission to the Bar of this Court prior to the commencement of the next Term of Court.
